Class SightTracker

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.SightTracker
public final class SightTracker extends Object
Turns the mask statistics of the newest frame into what the agent is told about the opponent's position, adding two things a player has without thinking about them:
  • Knowing its own head movement. A frame is always a little old. If the camera has turned since it was taken, the positions measured on it are shifted to where they are now, using nothing but the agent's own view angles. Without this the agent corrects twice for an error it has already fixed, swings past the target and wobbles around it.
  • Remembering where the opponent went. Which side it was last seen on and how long ago, so there is something to act on once it has left the screen.
Everything here comes from pixels and the agent's own camera; no ground truth is involved.
